title: The Burnt Asset
author: A. M. Reyes
blurb: Rafael Crane, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must burn the network that did the training before the summit convenes.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
